summary: Acura Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting two $100,000 loans from Abuse Deterrent Pharma, LLC on September 18 and October 2, 2026, bringing the secured promissory note principal to $11,294,279 with roughly $1,365,000 accrued interest as of September 30, 2026, at 5.25% (7.5% default). Proceeds fund day-to-day operations. Management warns that absent additional financing by mid-October 2026, it must scale back, furlough or lay off employees, terminate operations, or seek bankruptcy protection, risking complete loss of shareholder value. Watch liquidity and any bankruptcy filing.
